statements.status_notes: GO-2026-6905 (no CVE id): github.com/blakesmith/ar Reader.Next accepts a negative member size from an archive header, and the next Reader.Read then panics with a slice bounds error, so a crafted ar archive or .deb file crashes a program that reads it (https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6905, https://github.com/blakesmith/ar/issues/16). There is no fixed version: the issue is open and the module has had no commit since 2019. Checked every scout-cli-dev package published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository by 2026-11-27: 25 builds, 1.20.4-r1 to 1.30.0-r1, each for x86_64 and aarch64. Each holds one file, /usr/bin/docker-scout, the Docker Scout CLI, a Go program built with CGO_ENABLED=0 for GOOS=linux. The -dev build has the same Go release and module versions as the scout-cli build of the same version, built without the -w linker flag and without -trimpath. We downloaded all 50 of these packages (each matching its index checksum) and read the Go build information (go version -m) and the function table (go tool nm) of every program. Every build ships github.com/blakesmith/ar v0.0.0-20190502131153-809d4375e1fb, the latest commit, with no replace directive, and every program links ar.(*Reader).Read. We did not establish which Docker Scout CLI commands reach this reader; because it is linked in every build and no fixed version exists, every published build is treated as affected.
